definitions.name: G2C.STDDEV
definitions.note: population standard deviation of a numeric Vector, bare scalar

definitions.name: G2C.NORMALIZE
definitions.body: 'G2C.XS' BIND G2C.XS G2C.XS G1A.MIN - G2C.XS G1A.RANGE /
definitions.note: rescale each number to (x - min) / (max - min), Vector in original order

definitions.name: G2C.LENS
definitions.note: Vector of the character length of each space-separated word of a String

definitions.name: G2C.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'G2C.C' BIND G2C.C [ 1 ] TAKE JOIN UPPER G2C.C [ 1 ] DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: one non-empty word String with its first letter upper-cased

definitions.name: G2C.TITLE
definitions.body: G0A.WORDS [ G2C.CAP ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN CHARS [ -1 ] DROP JOIN
definitions.note: title-case a space-separated String: each word capitalized, joined by single spaces

definitions.name: G2C.ACRONYM
definitions.body: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET ] MAP JOIN UPPER
definitions.note: upper-cased first letters of every word of a String, as one String
